   258	 * asn1_get_octet_der:
   259	 * @der: DER data to decode containing the OCTET SEQUENCE.
   260	 * @der_len: The length of the @der data to decode.
   261	 * @ret_len: Output variable containing the encoded length of the DER data.
   262	 * @str: Pre-allocated output buffer to put decoded OCTET SEQUENCE in.
   263	 * @str_size: Length of pre-allocated output buffer.
   264	 * @str_len: Output variable containing the length of the contents of the OCTET SEQUENCE.
   265	 *
   266	 * Extract an OCTET SEQUENCE from DER data. Note that this function
   267	 * expects the DER data past the tag field, i.e., the length and
   268	 * content octets.
   269	 *
   270	 * Returns: Returns %ASN1_SUCCESS on success, or an error.
   271	 **/
   272	int
   273	asn1_get_octet_der (const unsigned char *der, int der_len,
   274	                    int *ret_len, unsigned char *str, int str_size,
   275	                    int *str_len)
   276	{
   277	  int len_len = 0;
   278	
   279	  if (der_len <= 0)
   280	    return ASN1_GENERIC_ERROR;
   281	
   282	  *str_len = asn1_get_length_der (der, der_len, &len_len);
   283	
   284	  if (*str_len < 0)
   285	    return ASN1_DER_ERROR;
   286	
   287	  *ret_len = *str_len + len_len;
   288	  if (str_size >= *str_len)
   289	    {
   290	      if (*str_len > 0 && str != NULL)
   291	        memcpy (str, der + len_len, *str_len);
   292	    }
   293	  else
   294	    {
   295	      return ASN1_MEM_ERROR;
   296	    }
   297	
   298	  return ASN1_SUCCESS;
   299	}
